notes: Idea: compute the Bayes-optimal noisy secretary policy (Longstaff-Schwartz on exact posterior summaries p_t, w_t) with a clairvoyant upper bound. Finding: the policy reaches 0.589/0.382/0.220/0.103 at sigma 0/0.5/1/2 vs 0.376/0.244/0.149/0.076 for the margin rule, which closes only 6-8% of the cutoff-to-Bayes gap; sigma=0 matches the exact Gilbert-Mosteller optimum (0.5888 vs 0.5893). Misspecification: assuming 2x noise drops it to 0.111, below the cutoff's 0.143. Verification: 12 unit tests pass (/usr/bin/python3); research/_homepage/build.py ok; check_md_links, research_live_links, programme_check, check_post_links, check_post_frontmatter, post_similarity all pass. Graduation candidate: empirical-Bayes version that learns sigma from the stream.
